author: Ankit
problem: allowed is a comma-separated list of promo codes such as 'SAVE10,WELCOME'. Return whether the code a customer typed is one of them, ignoring capitalization and surrounding spaces.
bug_description: Checks whether the code appears anywhere in the allowed text instead of in the list of codes, so partial codes like 'SAVE' are accepted.

comments.accurate: True if the typed code matches one of the allowed promo codes
comments.wrong_behavior: True if the typed code appears in the allowed promo-code text
comments.wrong_location: Code lookup verified; check that an empty code is rejected
